## Engineering Competencies & Core Capabilities
- **Software & Web Development**: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, responsive web architecture, REST APIs, Cloudflare Workers, and serverless edge computing.
- **Android & Mobile Engineering**: Native Android development with Kotlin & Android Studio, cross-platform apps with Flutter & Dart, signed release packaging, and lightweight mobile utilities.
- **Linux Systems & Cybersecurity**: System administration across Debian, Arch Linux & Kali Linux, command-line automation, ethical security fundamentals, and wireless protocol auditing.
- **Networking & MikroTik**: Practical MikroTik router configuration, IP routing, bandwidth management, and local LAN/WLAN setups.
- **Hardware Diagnostics & Electronics**: Phone & laptop hardware-level repairs, screen/battery troubleshooting, component testing, practical electronics, and home electrical wiring.
- **Published Author & Literature**: Author of 12 published volumes on Google Play Books across Science Fiction, Cyberpunk, Business, Philosophy, and Poetry.
